name: Bug report
about: Report a bug in Trash Tests
title: "[bug]: "
labels: bug
assignees: ''
---

## Describe the bug

A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

## To reproduce

Steps to reproduce the behavior:

1. Run `npx trashtests scan ...`
2. See error

## Expected behavior

What you expected to happen.

## Actual behavior

What actually happened. Include the output (or relevant excerpt).

## Environment

- Trash Tests version: [e.g., 0.1.0]
- Node version: [e.g., 20.10.0]
- pnpm version: [e.g., 9.12.0]
- OS: [e.g., macOS 14.2]
- Test runner: [e.g., Vitest 2.1.0, Jest 29.7.0]

## Reproduction

If possible, attach:

- The test file that triggered the bug
- The `--json` output
- A minimal reproduction (repo or single file)

## Rule ID (if applicable)

If this is a false positive in a specific rule, name it (e.g., `no-assertion`, `trivial-assertion`).
